finalText:
**Rename is large, not a find and replace.**

`account_id` sits on 1082 lines. Most are in the five services. Those are safe to rename in one pass.

Four spots must keep the name:

| Where | Why |
|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml:16](docs/openapi.yaml:16), [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) right side | Public API. Frozen field. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | Vendored. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites it. |
| `migrations/*.sql` | Applied history. Add a new `ALTER TABLE` migration. |
| JSONB `payload`, audit lines, `req.session` | Stored data and auth set that name. |

Next: sign off on code only. Require the new migration.
